Plugin.Name: Simple Docker Folders
Plugin.Overview:
An Unraid plugin that groups containers on the Docker tab into collapsible folders.
Click a folder row to expand or collapse it. Each folder row has buttons to start, stop or restart all of its containers, and to edit the folder. A folder can have a custom image (it is resized to 128×128 PNG in the browser). Folders sit at the position of their first container, so Unraid's own drag-sort order still applies. There are no settings pages. A docker container folder plugin should not have 20598324095724052094+ options. I just want to group containers to tidy up. If thats also what you want, then this plugin is for you.
